slots.title: U.S. session recap — Oct. 22, 2026
slots.body:
The Nasdaq Composite closed at 26,008.86, down 2.6%, its steepest daily drop reflected in session coverage tied to AI spending concerns.
The S&P 500 lost 1.2% to 7,662.54, while the Dow Jones Industrial Average barely moved, finishing at 52,867.98 (0.0%).
The Russell 2000 edged up 0.1% to 2,784.03.

The VIX rose 14.1% to 19.03, matching a session where equity volatility picked up alongside the tech decline.

At 12:30 p.m.
ET the Labor Department release showed initial jobless claims at 194K vs a 200K estimate, with continuing claims at 1,728K vs a 1,720K estimate and the four-week average at 197.75K.

Sector averages on Nasdaq showed Real Estate down 3.1%, Communication Services down 2.7%, Industrials down 2.7%, Utilities down 2.5%, Technology down 1.9%, and Energy down 2.0%.
Financial Services rose 1.6%, Basic Materials 1.6%, Consumer Defensive 1.3%, and Healthcare 0.8%.

Megacap tech sold off: $AMZN −4.6% to 250.38, $NVDA −4.4% to 212.21, $MSFT −2.2% to 521.08, and $GOOGL −3.1% to 324.22.
$AAPL bucked the group, up 1.2% to 348.22.

Semiconductors and related hardware were among the hardest-hit large names: $AMD −8.1%, $ASML −6.9%, $WDC −6.4%, and $AVGO −4.3%.
$WDC reported EPS of $4.64 vs a $4.11 estimate and revenue of $4.38B vs a $4.14B estimate.

Procter & Gamble ($PG) rose 5.6% to 165.59 after EPS of $2.00 vs $1.88 estimated and revenue of $23.28B vs $22.80B estimated.
Lockheed Martin ($LMT) gained 7.0% to 589.91 on EPS of $7.97 vs $7.52 estimated and revenue of $20.71B vs $20.48B estimated.
Blackstone ($BX) closed up 8.4% to 118.75 (EPS $1.32 vs $1.26 est.).
Roper Technologies ($ROP) was up 9.7% to 436.23 (EPS $5.89 vs $5.79 est.).
Nasdaq, Inc. ($NDAQ) rose 7.5% to 103.30 (EPS $1.04 vs $1.02 est.).

Cross-asset moves included Brent crude at 113.85 (+0.6%), the United States Oil Fund ($USO) at 162.51 (+1.7%), gold futures at 4,029.70 (−0.8%), the Invesco dollar fund ($UUP) at 28.90 (−0.1%), and Bitcoin at 81,642.09 (+0.4%).

Overseas indexes in the feed included the Nikkei 225 at 61,825.26 (−1.7%), the FTSE 100 at 10,725.03 (−0.3%), and the Hang Seng at 23,020.68 (+0.4%).

Treasury yield levels in the injected snapshot (dated 2026-10-20) showed the 10-year at 5.1% and the 2s10s spread at 0.33 percentage points.
